title: Synthetic Medical Data Generation - Capgemini
summary: A Capgemini-sponsored practicum project that generates synthetic medical and pharmacy insurance claims data using GPT-2 finetuning and tabular synthesis methods, then evaluates the outputs statistically. It runs SDV's single-table API directly, fitting GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer on claims data and using sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic to assess synthetic data fidelity.
evidence: SDV_Notebook.ipynb:533-538 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata) and samples 100000 rows; Medical_Eval.ipynb:870 imports CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer
